global_caption: The video contains 7 shots and is a watercolor picture book-style smartphone advertisement short film, set in a fantastical world of neutral-toned city streets with inverted gravity. The overall palette features neutral colors such as gray-blue, off-white, and light graphite. Lighting consistently uses natural diffused daylight under overcast skies, supplemented by cool metallic reflections from the phone's edges caused by wind and moist air. There is no All text cards and interface information are uniformly in Chinese, maintaining a cold, slightly mysterious emotional tone.
shot1: Shot 1 opens with fade-in from black, wide-angle upward composition. Foreground features a road sign extending upward toward “天空”, mid-ground shows an anime-style girl lightly stepping onto its edge, background displays inverted buildings growing downward along the frame’s top, streetlights, wires, and signs hanging defying normal gravity. Composition uses building perspective lines to draw attention to her and the city center, shallow depth of field keeps girl and sign edge sharpest. Overcast diffused lighting reveals visible paper-like watercolor texture, with slight damp reflections on building edges. As she steps and stabilizes, her hem and hair flutter in the wind, creating the first impression of gravity anomaly. A dense Chinese text card “反重力登场” suddenly overlays from bottom-left to center, layered like printed posters with subtle paper fibers and ink bleed effects, appearing via rapid vertical compression and slight jittering. Camera slowly tilts up with minimal push-in. Wind
shot2: Shot 2 hard cuts from previous shot, medium-level low-angle view, camera pans along girl’s forward direction. Foreground occasionally sweeps past inverted streetlights and floating papers, mid-ground locks on her walking along tilted street, background shows flipped shop windows and reversed signage. Composition keeps subject at right third, leaving left side for motion direction and world-building cues. Lighting remains calm and soft natural daylight. Phone not yet fully revealed, only a glimpse of cool metallic edge at sleeve. She walks while smoothly pulling phone from loose sleeve, motion fluid and natural; wrist rotation causes brief reflections between phone edge and fine raindrops in wind. Camera pan includes slight follow inertia. Wind
shot3: Shot 3 hard cuts to close-up, eye-level framing, focus entirely on phone’s metal frame and camera module. Foreground has blurred moisture layer and passing droplets, background compressed into abstract color blocks of inverted street. Shallow depth of field sharpens camera module texture and chamfer highlights. Natural cool light glides over metal surface, as if gently polished by wind, with localized wet glow from post-rain air. Girl’s finger steadily supports phone, body slightly rotating, revealing corners, lens ring, and layered surfaces—retaining metal’s refined rigidity even in watercolor style. Vertical text card “冷雕一体机身” overlays right side, material semi-transparent cool silver foil with faint glowing outline, appearing via scratch-like transition from blur to clarity. Camera performs extremely slow lateral micro-move with slight push-in. Wind
shot4: Shot 4 connects via brief dissolve transition to tighter close-up, slightly overhead but near eye-level. Screen dominates frame, foreground shows fingertip about to touch it, background reflects inverted sky and reversed tram sliding across glass surface. Central composition centers on high-reflection area of screen, surrounding frame retains minimal phone border for stability. Lighting still dominated by overcast soft light, but screen reflection clearer than before, with distinct bright and dark zones. Girl’s fingertip touches screen, interface transitions from off to on, sky, tram, and lit UI momentarily superimposed, demonstrating screen clarity and responsiveness. Tiny water spots on glass slide outward with fingertip motion. Camera gently pushes in and stabilizes at moment of activation. Wind
shot5: Shot 5 hard cuts to action sequence, wide-angle level-to-follow perspective. Girl leaps from inverted street corner toward floating zebra crossing. Foreground features suspended marking fragments, mid-ground shows airborne body still firmly gripping phone, background displays slowly flipping shop facades and distant reverse-moving tram. Lighting remains consistent, overcast natural light keeps environment soft, but phone screen and edges flash brighter during leap, forming visual climax. Her motion—push-off, lift-off, clearing floating crosswalk—is seamless, hair, skirt, laces, and fabric edges clearly trailing in airflow. Phone remains stable and visible during motion. Camera initially follows rapidly then slightly lifts. Wind
shot6: Shot 6 connects via speed-matched edit to product showcase, near-close-up, eye-level slightly upward. Phone hovers above girl’s open palm. Foreground shows blurred paper scraps swept by wind, background blurred wall street scene and flipped neon lights. Composition uses central stabilization, phone absolute focal point, palm merely supporting. Depth of field shallower, edges and buttons clearest. Cool natural light wraps around body, edges outlined by flowing air with thin highlight. Buttons and corners light up sequentially during rotation. Phone slowly rotates, showcasing frame, buttons, backplate joints, and overall proportions. Girl’s hand remains steady, fingertips slightly curled, wind acting like invisible sculptor polishing each facet. Camera performs small circular orbit, creating floating sensation. Wind
shot7: Shot 7 connects via fade-in/fade-out to closing image, wide-angle pull-back, camera shifts from level to slight upward tilt. Girl now stands on vertical wall, as if it were ground, raising arm to hold phone toward inverted sky, entire anti-gravity city unfolding behind her. Composition places figure below-center, phone raised forming visual apex, inverted buildings and street lines radiating outward, drawing gaze back to phone and slogan. Overcast diffused lighting maintains unified world. Phone edge receives final clear cool glow, girl’s silhouette softly outlined by moist air. After traversing, extracting, activating, and leaping in prior shots, she completes static display pose. Large text layout “把城市翻过来” fills center to right, using large-scale poster-style Chinese sans-serif font, material mix of wet ink and silver foil, some characters resting on building facades, others spanning sky areas, entrance effect pulled from distant city plane, layering and settling into place. Camera continuously pulls back with slight upward tilt, incorporating both figure and city into frame. Wind
